args.subject: Child seat availability inquiry
args.body:
Hello,

I'm interested in renting a car from New Car Rental in London. Could you please let me know whether you have child seats available for rental, and if so, what sizes/types and any additional cost?

Thank you,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
